title: Root headline says no tax in either jurisdiction and uses 0.42% as the conversion cost
detail: Root EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md says “no tax on converting or transferring your own money in either jurisdiction” and “real cost … about 0.42%”. data/costs.json K1 correctly calls 0.4199% a round-trip spread, and K22/§988 shows personal FX gain >USD 200 can be recognised. The headline overclaims both tax and one-way cost.
action: Rewrite headline to separate principal, FX gain, round-trip vs one-way proxy, and reporting penalties. Edition F does not edit the root file.

title: Root deposit-interest row says 20% withheld and “nets 80%”
detail: data/costs.json K9 interest/dividends row (which says a CNY deposit nets 80% of its coupon) states a CNY deposit already nets 80% of its coupon and that 20% withholding is the only Chinese tax most savers pay. Official 财税〔2008〕132号 and STA Q&A temporarily exempt savings-deposit interest (RMB and foreign currency) from 2008-10-09.
action: Correct savings-deposit interest treatment; do not generalise the exemption to all interest/dividends.

title: Root/dossier date the BOC spread as measured 2026-11-08
detail: data/channels.json and dossier text describe the 0.42% spread as measured on 2026-11-08, while the retrieved BOC board displays 2026-11-09. Rates are identical in this capture, but the timestamp claim is not supported.
action: Label capture date vs board display date; treat as reference-only scenario.

title: Root quota schedule implies a two-person household halves the time
detail: data/costs.json K6 says a two-person household halves the quota schedule. Using another person’s quota for one person’s funds is splitting/borrowing unless each person has their own lawful funds and purpose.
action: Remove or qualify household halving; do not present quota borrowing as a lawful schedule.

title: Edition C states adjusted FBAR dollars without a retrieved adjusted table
detail: edition-c/data/penalties.json, tax.json and summary.json state adjusted maxima USD 16,536 / USD 165,353. This session read IRM 4.26.16 and 31 USC 5321 but not an official current-year adjusted table, so those dollars are not independently verified here.
action: Leave adjusted dollars blank until the current official table is read; keep statutory framework and Bittner note.

title: Edition C “only two lawful routes move a whole balance” is overbroad
detail: Edition C README/summary says only emigrant and inheritance transfers move a whole balance for individuals. Art.59 documented current-account income, property-sale proceeds under the 2025 guide, and corporate liquidation/dividend routes can move larger amounts where their own conditions are met.
action: Qualify by source of funds and route conditions; do not present the 2004 property-transfer limbs as the only large-value paths.

title: Edition C process irregularities I01/I02 are historical, not current verification
detail: edition-c/data/repo-review.json records tasks pre-marked done (I01) and assembled URLs (I02). These are useful process warnings, but they do not verify the current site’s external links or factual correctness.
action: Keep historical flags; require current build/link/arithmetic checks and manual source re-opening.

title: Merged Edition D uses a named Chase receiving fee as an assumption in “total cost”
detail: edition-d/data/parameters.json receiving_bank.usd=15 is labelled an assumption from a Chase business schedule, yet the portal/summary presents modelled total cost as the answer. The user required unverifiable values to stay blank; a named example is not the user’s receiving-bank fee.
action: Keep correspondent/receiving fees blank or show a separate labelled example outside the verified total. Edition F base known cost excludes them.

title: Merged Edition D relies on an older BOC e-banking tariff and a corporate full-amount notice
detail: edition-d/data/parameters.json boc_personal_wire effective 2014-11-01 and correspondent full-amount source is a trade-finance/corporate announcement. Edition F read BOC’s current personal tariff effective 2025-11-11, which contains the personal TT/cable and full-arrival notes.
action: Prefer the current personal tariff; label optional full-arrival charges as conditional, not universal.

title: Merged Edition D one-way margin denominator differs from Edition F
detail: Merged D computes one-way margin as (ask-mid)/mid = 0.2103%; Edition F computes (ask-mid)/ask = 0.2099239% and round-trip (ask-bid)/ask = 0.4198479%. Both are transparent proxies if labelled; neither is an executable mid-market cost.
action: State the denominator and comparator. Do not call either number a tax or a guaranteed saving.

title: Open PR #12 targets the same edition-d path and is conflicting
detail: GitHub reports PR #12 (arena/e748c15f) OPEN and CONFLICTING after PR #13 merged a different edition-d. Its model also uses labelled assumptions for unverified fees. Merging it without resolution could overwrite or duplicate the merged edition.
action: Owner should rebase/resolve and remove assumption-based totals or clearly separate them. This session does not merge/close another session’s PR.

title: HSBC “Premier free overseas transfer” is product-specific, not universal
detail: Search/marketing summaries can imply all Premier overseas wires are free. HSBC’s current tariff charges ordinary Premier/Advance third-party wires 0.1% (min100/max500) + CNY120 cable; free local fees apply to private-banking personal, Elite, and qualifying same-name Global Transfer products, excluding non-HSBC charges.
action: Use the tariff item and product condition, not the marketing shorthand.

title: Internal checkers passed while external dead links and overclaims remained
detail: All inherited build/verify suites passed at claim time, but root data contains a dead uscode.house.gov granule URL and earlier editions contain timestamp/adjusted-penalty overclaims. Internal consistency is not external verification.
action: Add manual source re-opening and claim-level audit; do not equate green CI with factual correctness.

title: Expired BOC e-banking promotion must not be used as current pricing
detail: Earlier research encountered a BOC 2025 e-banking promotion expiring 2025-12-31. Edition F uses the personal tariff effective 2025-11-11 and the 2026-11-11 ATM announcement instead.
action: Check effective dates; future-effective ATM changes are not applied before 2026-11-11.

title: Concurrent editions created repeated scope collisions (D, E and F)
detail: PR #13 merged edition-d and a root portal; PR #12 remains open against edition-d; PRs #15/#16 then merged a different edition-e while this session was preparing its own edition-e. This session preserved all merged work and relocated its deliverable to edition-f. It does not merge/close another session’s PR.
action: Keep file scopes disjoint and re-check origin/main immediately before PR/merge; root owner integrates links; do not merge conflicting duplicate editions without owner resolution.

title: Merged Edition E is a separate concurrent deliverable, not this edition
detail: Session arena-0614c102 merged edition-e at 7ce3a7f/1ed1fe7 with 32 methods, 1,280 grid rows and its own verifier. Edition F is an additional independent verification edition under edition-f/; it does not overwrite edition-e or adopt its numbers.
action: Readers should compare editions by source date and model inputs; root portal owner may link both. Edition F keeps unknown personal/corridor values blank.
